editorial:
Imagine waking up in an empty New York City where every street is silent and every building feels like a ghost town. That is the world Robert Neville faces after a man-made virus wipes out almost everyone. He is immune, so he spends his days hunting for food, trying to find a cure in his lab, and sending radio messages to anyone who might still be alive. At night, he hides from the infected creatures that come out in the dark. The movie mixes lonely drama with tense survival moments, and Will Smith carries it with a strong, emotional performance. You feel his fear, his routine, and his hope.

The action scenes are exciting, especially when Neville gets trapped outside after dark or faces the infected up close. The pacing is mostly fast, though some quiet scenes slow things down in a good way. The CGI creatures look a bit dated now, but the tension still works. If you like survival thrillers with heart, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Neville discovers the infected are actually intelligent and have been watching him. When they attack his home, he realizes his cure works. He gives a vial of the cure to a survivor named Anna and her son, then sacrifices himself by blowing up the lab to stop the creatures. Anna and her son escape to a safe colony, where she hands over the cure. The twist is that Neville becomes a legend because his sacrifice saves humanity, not because he survived.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers with emotional stakes.
